sources.title: Prices of State-Contingent Claims Implicit in Option Prices
sources.authors: Douglas T. Breeden and Robert H. Litzenberger
sources.claim: Original derivation: the state-price density equals the second derivative of the call price with respect to strike.

sources.title: Options and the Gamma Knife
sources.venue: Journal of Portfolio Management (special issue in memory of Stephen A. Ross)
sources.claim: Inspected at equation (1) and footnote 2: price of a claim to g(S_T) equals the integral of g(K) times the second derivative of the call price in K; call prices are convex so the second derivative exists almost everywhere.

sources.title: Heaviside step function
sources.claim: Inspected: d/dx max{x,0} = H(x) and the distributional derivative dH/dx = delta(x), hence the second distributional derivative of max{x,0} is the Dirac delta.
